what: The agentic CI fixer plan reuses `stage_and_push` after Opus edits but does not require the mechanical forbidden-path/submodule guards that `run_lint_fix` applies before accepting coder output (`checks.py:1881-2013`).
scenario_or_breakage: Up to 20 autonomous fix→verify→push cycles let Opus commit and push `.gitmodules` or submodule-path edits that lint-fix would reset; trust boundary is weaker on the expanded ship-pr write path.
suggested_fix: Before each `stage_and_push`, add the same forbidden-path scan/revert used in `run_lint_fix` (or a shared helper) and fail the cycle without push when forbidden paths appear in the delta.
